title: Hollywood star joins battle to save grotto
text: US actress Helena Bonham Carter has joined the campaign to try to save a historic South London grotto from developers. The actress, who supports the conservation of the Grotto at St Mary and the Grotto, said the site was of outstanding importance. The grotto is one of the last remaining examples of its kind in the world and is visited by thousands of people each year.

title: India central bank raises rates
text: Indias central bank has raised its main lending rate for the first time in three years to fight rising inflation. The Reserve Bank of India increased the repo rate by a quarter of a percentage point to 6.5%. Inflation has been running above the level the bank is comfortable with, driven largely by higher food prices and the cost of imported oil.

title: New Samsung phones get slimmer designs
text: Samsung has launched its latest family of mobile phones, with a pair of new models targeting the high end of the market. The handsets are thinner than their predecessors and feature brighter touchscreens. Analysts said the firm's focus on design and screen quality reflects the growing importance of premium handsets as cheap devices become more common.

title: Low turnout at local elections
text: Local council elections across the country produced a low turnout, early estimates suggest. Party officials said apathy among younger voters was a key factor in the disappointing figures. The final numbers will be published when all the ballots have been counted.

title: England edge past Wales in friendly
text: England secured a narrow victory over Wales in a friendly international at the weekend. A single goal in the second half proved the difference in a match dominated by midfield that rarely threatened to break the deadlock. The result gives Coach the first win of his new term.
